'''Warwick''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who hid on a ridge alongside [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] as the latter discussed how to infiltrate the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ novel" />
